title: Fairness in Multi-modal Medical Diagnosis with Demonstration Selection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Average Disparity (AD) and Accuracy Difference (MaxAccGap) between gender groups (Male/Female) in medical image reasoning tasks using multimodal large language models.
Measuring Average Disparity (AD) and Accuracy Difference (MaxAccGap) between racial groups (White/Black/Asian) in medical image reasoning tasks using multimodal large language models.
Measuring Average Disparity (AD) and Accuracy Difference (MaxAccGap) between ethnicity groups (Hispanic/Non-Hispanic/Unknown) in medical image reasoning tasks using multimodal large language models.
